setupConcluded.title: The setup is concluded
setupConcluded.todo: The consultancy and its first administrator are registered. The administrator logs in below.

setupAlreadyConcluded.title: The setup was already concluded
setupAlreadyConcluded.todo: Someone concluded it before you did, so nothing of what you typed was saved. The administrator registered then logs in below.

setupConcludedWithoutAnswer.title: The setup is concluded
setupConcludedWithoutAnswer.todo: An earlier attempt to conclude it got no answer, so it may have concluded the setup with what you typed, or someone may have concluded it before you. The administrator registered then logs in below.

administratorRegistered.title: The administrator is registered
administratorRegistered.todo: The new administrator logs in below. The users that existed were not changed.

administratorRegisteredWithoutAnswer.title: The administrator may be registered
administratorRegisteredWithoutAnswer.todo: An earlier attempt to register the administrator got no answer, so it may have registered them with the e-mail typed then. Try logging in below with that e-mail. The users that existed were not changed.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.todo: Log in again to go back to where you were.

loggedOut.title: You logged out
loggedOut.todo: To use the system again, log in below.

email.intro: Type the e-mail you log in with, and a login code is sent to it.
email.label: E-mail

codeEnded.title: This code no longer works
codeEnded.todo: Ask for a new code and type the one in the new e-mail.

code.intro: If <email>{{email}}</email> belongs to a user, a login code was sent to it. Type its six digits.
code.label: Login code
code.newCodeIn: You can ask for a new code in {{wait, seconds}}.
